faqs.question: What is the SOLATION® ICP-MS used for?
faqs.answer: It's a multi-element trace analysis instrument, used for measuring metals and elements in clinical samples like blood and tissue, and environmental or food samples like water, soil, and agricultural products.

faqs.question: What sample types does Solation support?
faqs.answer: Confirmed matrices include urine, serum, plasma, whole blood, and tissue on the clinical side, and water, soil, food, beverage, and agricultural samples on the environmental and food side.

faqs.question: How do I set up Solation for metals-in-blood testing?
faqs.answer: Confirm your blood sample preparation requirements with Inkarp; whole blood is a confirmed compatible matrix for this application.

faqs.question: How do I choose the right application configuration?
faqs.answer: Match your lab type: clinical labs use Metals in Blood or Clinical/Biomedical applications, environmental labs use Environmental Analysis, food safety labs use Food & Agriculture, and pharmaceutical manufacturers use Pharmaceutical Quality Control.

faqs.question: Can the same instrument handle both clinical and environmental samples?
faqs.answer: Yes, the same Solation instrument and software cover both sample worlds; the distinction is in your sample matrix and application, not a different product configuration.

faqs.question: Is Solation suitable for pharmaceutical quality control?
faqs.answer: Yes, this is a confirmed dedicated application, distinct from expression CMS's confirmed applications.

faqs.question: How difficult is Solation to operate day to day?
faqs.answer: It's designed specifically for ease of use, with intuitive software, positioned to not require a dedicated ICP-MS specialist.

faqs.question: What detection limits does Solation achieve?
faqs.answer: This is confirmed directly by Inkarp based on your specific elements and matrix.

faqs.question: What is the price of the SOLATION® ICP-MS in India?
faqs.answer: The price depends on your configuration and application requirements. Contact Inkarp for a quotation once your sample matrix is confirmed.

longForm.heroLead: Clinical samples and environmental samples usually mean two different instruments, two different workflows, two different validation paths. Solation is built to be the one instrument that handles both. It measures trace elements with high sensitivity across genuinely complex matrices: urine, serum, plasma, whole blood, and tissue on one side, water, soil, food, beverage, and agricultural samples on the other. Intuitive software keeps multi-element analysis simple and robust, not something that needs a dedicated specialist to run day to day.

sections.title: SOLATION® ICP-MS at a Glance
sections.description: Everything you need to evaluate Solation: which sample matrices are confirmed compatible, which applications it fits, how it's positioned for ease of use, and Inkarp installation and service support.
sections.subheading: From whole blood to soil samples. One ICP-MS handles every matrix with high sensitivity.
body: The matrix range genuinely spans two worlds. Clinical samples like whole blood and tissue, and environmental samples like soil and water, both confirmed on the same instrument.
Multi-element analysis is the core capability. High sensitivity trace element measurement, not single-element targeted testing.
Ease of use is a stated design goal, not an afterthought. Intuitive software is called out specifically, alongside simplicity and robustness.
Application coverage is broad and named. Metals in blood, environmental analysis, clinical/biomedical work, food and agriculture, and pharmaceutical quality control are all confirmed.

Some applications share pages with expression CMS. Environmental Analysis, Clinical work, and Food-related applications link to the same underlying Advion content confirmed on the CMS page, just labeled slightly differently here.
This source stays at the overview level. No detection limit, plasma power, or throughput figure is stated, so none is invented here either.
The positioning is "everywhere," not "specialist only." Environmental, pharmaceutical, food safety, and clinical labs are all named as ideal fits.
Confirmed solution: Advion Interchim Scientific SOLATION® ICP-MS.
Confirmed sample matrices: urine, serum, plasma, whole blood, tissue, water, soil, food, beverage, agricultural samples.
Confirmed applications: Metals in Blood, Environmental Analysis, Clinical/Biomedical, Food & Agriculture, Pharmaceutical Quality Control.

sections.title: Matrix Range and Sample Types
body: Two genuinely different sample worlds are confirmed compatible here, and knowing which one your lab works in shapes the rest of the configuration conversation.

On the clinical side, urine, serum, plasma, whole blood, and tissue are all confirmed matrices, supporting work like metals-in-blood testing directly. On the environmental and food side, water, soil, food, beverage, and agricultural samples are confirmed, covering the kind of trace element work environmental and food safety labs run routinely. The instrument itself doesn't distinguish between these categories operationally, the same multi-element sensitivity applies across both.
